summary: Sets the driver visibility flags (bits 1 and 2) at this+0x48BC. When the show argument is non-zero, ORs in 6 (visible); when it is zero, clears those bits with 0xFFFFFFF9 (hidden). After showing, if the vehicle at dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54DC] + 18580 (0x4894) matches this+0x4894 (i.e. the vehicle is the player's), gates the engine sound through StateCheckWithTernaryLogic of the session state at dword_5EA510 and plays it via AudioSoundEffectController; otherwise plays the external-vehicle sound. Hiding always plays the stop sound (3). Called by CollisionContactIteration and LoadingPhase2.

local_names.this: driver/vehicle state object whose visibility flags and team are modified and read
local_names.a2: show flag; non-zero shows the driver, zero hides it
local_names.v3: previous value of the visibility flags dword at this+0x48BC
local_names.v4: session state check result from StateCheckWithTernaryLogic used as the audio effect parameter

operations.description: Reads the current visibility flags dword at this+0x48BC into v3
Branches on the show flag a2: non-zero takes the show path, zero takes the hide path
Show path: writes v3 OR 6 back to this+0x48BC, setting visibility bits 1 and 2
Compares the player vehicle team dword at dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54DC] + 18580 against this+0x4894 to decide whether this is the player's own vehicle
Own-vehicle show path: evaluates the session state through StateCheckWithTernaryLogic(dword_5EA510) to decide whether the engine sound should play
Own-vehicle show path: returns the result of AudioSoundEffectController(v4), playing the engine effect
Other-vehicle show path: returns the result of AudioSoundEffectController(0), playing the external-vehicle engine effect
Hide path: writes v3 AND 0xFFFFFFF9 back to this+0x48BC, clearing visibility bits 1 and 2
Hide path: returns the result of AudioSoundEffectController(3), playing the stop sound
Returns the AudioSoundEffectController result on every branch
Invoked by CollisionContactIteration and LoadingPhase2 during their handling of driver/vehicle visibility

unresolved: The relationship between this+0x4894 and the vehicle at dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54DC]+18580 is described as a team comparison in existing analysis but the equality check itself is only demonstrated by the raw source; the concrete meaning of the dword at 18580 is not proven here
AudioSoundEffectController parameter meanings (0, 3, and the session-check result) are taken from existing analysis and are not self-evident from this packet alone
